title: FRagmentation and Evolution of Dense Cores Judged by ALMA (FREJA). I. Overview: Inner ∼1000 au Structures of Prestellar/Protostellar Cores in Taurus
question: What are the inner ~1000 au structures of prestellar/protostellar cores in Taurus, and how long do high-density prestellar cores last before protostar formation?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.3 mm); effective continuum frequency 225.3 GHz
data.arrays: ACA 7 m array plus Total Power array, stand-alone

what.value: Distances to Taurus clouds (140 pc for L1521)

evidence.quote: Distance measurements toward individual clouds in Taurus by (cite: Galli18).

what.value: NH3 kinetic temperatures used as dust temperatures

evidence.quote: Kinematic temperature derived from NH$_3$ observations
$\kappa_{\rm 1.3\,mm}$ = 0.005 cm${^2}$ g$^{-1}$ for prestellar cores (cite: Ossenkopf94; Preibisch93)

what.value: Higher-resolution interferometric disk fluxes for protostellar sources

evidence.quote: We compiled higher-resolution interferometric observations at the same frequency from the literature for all protostellar sources

what.value: Prestellar core catalog of 44 cores and lifetime ~4e5 yr

evidence.quote: (cite: Onishi02) discovered 44 prestellar cores with an average density of $\gtrsim$10$^{5}$ cm$^{-3}$

recipe.goal: Image continuum and measure source properties
recipe.method: tclean multiscale natural-weighted continuum imaging, then 2D Gaussian fits after primary beam correction; rms from emission-free pixels
key_parameters: scales 0,6,18 pix; 1'' pixels; natural weighting; 3 sigma detection threshold

recipe.method: M = D^2 F / (kappa B(Td)); n(H2)=3M/(4 pi mu mH R^3)
assumptions: kappa_1.3mm=0.005 cm2/g; Td equals NH3 gas temperature, uniform

recipe.goal: Test whether substructures are interferometric artifacts
recipe.method: simobserve and tclean of smooth Plummer-like cores compared with observations; plus C18O and N2D+ line distributions
key_parameters: p=2; R_flat 8000,2500,1500,900,300 au; aspect ratios 1.0 and 1.8; kappa=0.005, Td=10 K

recipe.method: Divide 54 Taurus prestellar cores into categories I/II/III by continuum flux (21 mJy cut) and scale by total lifetime ~5e5 yr
assumptions: unobserved cores are category I; constant evolution speed; total lifetime ~5e5 yr
